The `Role` union is defined in `src/types/member.ts`. Under `src/`, 15 other files name the type. Each one imports it, and most also use it in type annotations or `Record<Role, …>` maps. I found them with a whole-word search for `Role`. I also checked that nothing imports it under another name or through the `@/types` barrel. The definition file is in the list too, because `ROLES`, `ROLE_RANK: Record<Role, number>` and `hasRoleAtLeast` all have to change there.

The files most likely to need real edits, not just a recompile, are the ones with `Record<Role, …>` maps. The compiler will reject these until the new role has an entry:
- `ROLE_RANK` in `src/types/member.ts`
- `ROLE_LABELS` in `src/lib/format.ts`
- `TONE_BY_ROLE` in `src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx`
- the zod enum in `src/schemas/role.ts`, which has a check that keeps it in step with the union

I read "source file" as the files under `src/`. Six test files also name `Role` and weren't counted:
- `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts`
- `tests/contract/permissions.test.ts`
- `tests/config/nav.test.ts`
- `tests/components/command-groups.test.ts`
- `tests/components/role-select.test.ts`
- `tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts`

The `scripts/manifest-parts` files only mention `Role` inside description strings, so they're out of scope. Files that only use `Actor` or `Member` are out too, as are files that pass role strings like `"member"` without naming the type.

ANSWER: src/types/member.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/permission.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, src/emails/invite-email.tsx, src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/schemas/role.ts, src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx, src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx, src/lib/permissions.ts, src/lib/format.ts
